assigned_test_proof.root_cause: AgentWorkflow._continuation_resume_state wrote runtime_state["context"] (the whole conversation) while _continuation_args also passed it as argument 6. The stuck agent (76aac11b, 384 messages) had a 1,032,403-byte context and a 1,050,698-byte resume_state: 2.08 MB per continue_as_new, over Temporal Cloud 2 MiB, so the SDK refused the upload ([TMPRL1103]) and the workflow task failed forever.
assigned_test_proof.causal_repro: agents/tests/blackbox/workflow.blackbox.py test_workflow_continuation_carries_the_context_once_so_large_agents_hand_off (registered as wf_continuation_carries_context_once, domain workflow): failed on the unfixed code (runtime_state contained context), passes after. A real Temporal dev server with Cloud 2 MiB blob limit (evidence/repro/temporal-continue-as-new-2mib-repro.py, output beside it) reproduces the exact TMPRL1103 wedge for the duplicated shape and a clean handoff for the single-copy shape.
